title: Adaptive verification with an intuition-like auxiliary signal: canonical v8 pipeline and results

creators.name: Velayutham S
creators.affiliation: BeliefRecode AI Pvt. Ltd., Chennai, India

description: Deterministic synthetic pipeline testing whether an auxiliary, intuition-like cue improves adaptive verification beyond model confidence, across a grid of cue information levels (L0-L4) and confidence-baseline informativeness (w_conf). Includes the generator, a matched-error-rate sensitivity analysis, all CSV outputs, audit checks, output hashes and an independent-rerun hash comparison.
